claims.exact_claim_text: Simulated federated training aggregated parameters across three clients without centrally pooling raw client training datasets
claims.evidence: _execute_federated_fedavg exchanges state_dicts only
claims.mandatory_caveat: No privacy mechanism; data generated centrally then partitioned; does not establish cryptographic privacy, secure aggregation, differential privacy, or legal compliance
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: secure / private / compliant / real-world deployment

claims.exact_claim_text: Across five canonical seeds, pooled ROC-AUC was higher for federated than isolated local training in 5/5 seeds, mean paired difference +0.1897 +/- 0.0204 (pooled concatenated bank-local test views)
claims.metric_population: Concatenated bank-local test views (8,019 rows in seed 42)
claims.mandatory_caveat: Pooled isolated score mixes three separately trained models; per-bank decomposition shows Bank A lower (5/5), Bank B lower (4/5), and Bank C higher (5/5); gain concentrated in zero-positive Bank C
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: federation improves every bank; statistical significance; causal mechanism

claims.exact_claim_text: Average Precision difference between federated and isolated was +0.0123 +/- 0.0138, positive in 4 of 5 seeds
claims.mandatory_caveat: Seed-dependent (negative in seed 456); per-bank AP mostly lower for Banks A and B
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: consistent AP gain across all seeds; uniform institutional benefit

claims.exact_claim_text: Recall difference at the validation-selected 0.1%-FPR threshold was +0.0032 +/- 0.0128 (2 positive, 2 negative, 1 zero paired difference)
claims.mandatory_caveat: Achieved test FPR is not exactly 0.1% (realized FPR 0.0011-0.0016); mixed directional outcome
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: systematic low-FPR detection superiority

claims.exact_claim_text: Federated per-bank ROC was lower than isolated for Bank A in 5/5 seeds (-0.0293 +/- 0.0104) and Bank B in 4/5 seeds (-0.0171 +/- 0.0226), while higher for Bank C in 5/5 seeds (+0.3514 +/- 0.2009)
claims.metric_population: Bank-local test partitions (Bank A, Bank B, Bank C)
claims.evidence: Per-bank test partition metrics stored in per_bank_metrics across all 5 seeds
claims.mandatory_caveat: Bank C isolated model was trained on negatives only; pooled gain is concentrated in Bank C rescue; causal mechanism not evaluated
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: uniform cross-institutional benefit; causal mechanism attribution

claims.exact_claim_text: Under the frozen executable matched-view comparison, federated training had higher AP than centralized training in all five seeds (mean paired difference +0.0325 +/- 0.0181)
claims.evidence: Per-seed dAP: +0.0487, +0.0470, +0.0294, +0.0037, +0.0335; federated mean 0.1779 vs centralized mean 0.1454
claims.mandatory_caveat: The centralized expanded-view construction is bound by the frozen executable source but was not independently encoded in the manifest; historical pre-execution prose used an inconsistent unique-transaction exposure count; optimizer states differ
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: universal winner claim; equivalence claim; optimization identity; causal mechanism

claims.exact_claim_text: Under the frozen executable matched-view comparison, centralized training had higher ROC-AUC than federated training in all five seeds (federated-minus-centralized mean paired difference -0.0079 +/- 0.0056)
claims.evidence: Per-seed dROC: -0.0060, -0.0094, -0.0079, -0.0158, -0.0002; centralized mean 0.9091 vs federated mean 0.9013
claims.mandatory_caveat: The centralized expanded-view construction is bound by the frozen executable source but was not independently encoded in the manifest; historical pre-execution prose used an inconsistent unique-transaction exposure count; optimizer states differ
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: universal winner claim; equivalence claim; optimization identity

claims.exact_claim_text: Federated training achieves statistical or empirical equivalence to centralized training (matches centralized)
claims.evidence: No equivalence test was preregistered; metrics diverge in opposite directions (AP favors federated, ROC favors centralized)
claims.mandatory_caveat: Metrics diverge; no margin was prespecified; matches centralized is retired
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: any equivalence or parity claim

claims.exact_claim_text: In the synthetic zero-positive Bank C setting, federated parameter sharing improved Bank C ranking metrics relative to isolated local training across all five seeds (mean dROC +0.3514 +/- 0.2009, mean dAP +0.1086 +/- 0.0596)
claims.metric_population: Bank C test partition (2,035 rows, 50 positive in seed 42)
claims.mandatory_caveat: Isolated Bank C comparator had 0 training positives and scored below chance (ROC 0.3296, 0.3337) in two seeds; did not translate into operational detection (CB-COLD-LOWFPR)
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: cold-start was solved; operational fraud detection in cold-start

claims.exact_claim_text: At the validation-selected 0.1% FPR operating regime, Bank C test recall remained 0% in all five seeds for the realistic local-feature federated condition
claims.mandatory_caveat: Ranking gains do not yield operational low-FPR detection
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: operational cold-start detection

claims.exact_claim_text: Under the realistic federated local-feature condition, 5 of 133 pooled Scenario 7 test incidents were detected across five seeds (3.76% pooled recall; 3.92% mean per-seed recall)
claims.metric_population: Deduplicated unique test transactions (133 pooled incidents across 5 seeds), source-bank scoring
claims.evidence: Detected / test incidents per seed: 1/26, 2/27, 0/27, 2/24, 0/29 (sum 5/133)
claims.mandatory_caveat: Scenario metrics use source-bank-only scoring pipeline while operating threshold is chosen from concatenated-view validation scores
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: reliable detection; impossibility without graph features

claims.exact_claim_text: Reliable Scenario 7 detection using the evaluated local-feature regime
claims.evidence: Pooled detection rate 3.76% (5/133) and centralized 0/133 confirm local features fail to provide reliable detection
claims.mandatory_caveat: First-class negative result
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: any claim of reliable detection

claims.exact_claim_text: The diagnostic oracle condition detected 133 of 133 Scenario 7 test incidents (100% recall)
claims.mandatory_caveat: Oracle feature (scenario_id is not None) is label-equivalent; provides zero evidence of graph or consortium intelligence
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: deployable detection; graph intelligence; consortium intelligence

claims.exact_claim_text: The generator-truth oracle condition, whose added input is a single binary feature equal to the label, achieved mean AP 0.8140 +/- 0.1133 and mean recall 0.7840 +/- 0.1112 at the validation-selected threshold
claims.mandatory_caveat: Input equals the label; sub-1.0 metrics reflect optimization/scaling dynamics; not an informational ceiling and not graph evidence
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: graph topology attribution; consortium intelligence; deployable performance

claims.exact_claim_text: The federated cross-bank detection system preserves privacy
claims.evidence: No differential privacy, secure aggregation, encryption, or inference-attack evaluation was performed
claims.mandatory_caveat: FedAvg exchanges model weights, not raw data, but weight exchange without cryptographic mechanisms does not prove privacy
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: any privacy, confidentiality, or compliance guarantee

claims.exact_claim_text: Results generalize to real-world banking environments
claims.evidence: Evaluated strictly on project-synthetic simulated transactions and simulated client processes
claims.mandatory_caveat: All monetary amounts and transaction topologies are synthetic; real-world generalizability is completely unmeasured
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: real-world effectiveness or deployability

claims.exact_claim_text: Detected synthetic Scenario 7 test incidents represented 104,904.05 SYNTHETIC_USD in pooled volume (mean 20,980.81 SYNTHETIC_USD per seed) out of 3,356,392.71 SYNTHETIC_USD total exposure
claims.evidence: Sum of amount column for detected positive Scenario 7 transactions across seeds
claims.mandatory_caveat: Synthetically generated numbers in SYNTHETIC_USD; does not represent real currency or prevented fraud
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: real financial recovery; prevented loss; chargebacks; ROI

claims.exact_claim_text: Synthetic monetary volume represents prevented fraud or direct chargeback savings
claims.evidence: The experiment does not measure prevention, avoided losses, operational intervention, or recovery
claims.mandatory_caveat: Absence of a measurement; not a negative result, but completely unmeasured
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: any prevention or recovery claim

claims.exact_claim_text: Q2 ROC improvement is statistically significant (p < 0.001)
claims.evidence: No hypothesis test or p-value was preregistered or computed by a stored procedure; Phase 3.1 t-test was retracted
claims.mandatory_caveat: Descriptive statistics only (mean +/- sample SD, paired differences)
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: any statistical significance claim

claims.exact_claim_text: Decentralized per-bank client batching regularizes against majority bank domination
claims.evidence: No factorial ablation separates batching from optimizer resets, scalers, or FedAvg weighting
claims.mandatory_caveat: Unverified post-hoc hypothesis
claims.forbidden_stronger_interpretation: any causal mechanism claim
